title: Masters of Horror
description:
S01 E09 — Fair Haired Child
Two youngsters, one kidnapped and one the son of the kidnappers, develop a special relationship while imprisoned together in a basement.

title: Fear Itself
description:
September Build
A family man is in a bad accident; as he hovers between life and death, the guy in the bed next to him, a serial killer, switches bodies with him.

title: Fear Itself
description:
S01 E02 — Spooked
A private eye has to face his demons while on a stakeout in a haunted house.

title: Grave Encounters
description: The crew of a ghost-hunting TV show goes insane after being locked in an abandoned psychiatric hospital.

title: Grave Encounters 2
description: Film students break into an abandoned insane asylum to do paranormal research and quickly discover ghosts are real.

title: Eat, Brains, Love
description: When Jake and his dream girl, Amanda, contract a mysterious zombie virus, they end up on the run from Cass, a teen psychic sent by the government's top-secret Necrotic Control Division to track them down as they search for a cure.

title: The Dresden Files
description:
S01 E08 — Storm Front
Harry must delve into the world of dark magic to solve the murders of a local gangster and his girlfriend.

title: The Dresden Files
description:
S01 E07 — Walls
Harry investigates a group of thieving college students who have discovered a supernatural method to bypass security systems.

title: Housebound
description: A would-be thief (Morgana O'Reilly) is remanded to the custody of her estranged mother (Rima Te Wiata), who turns out to be correct in her assertion that evil spirits are afoot in their family domicile.

title: Hide and Go Shriek
description: A teenager (Annette Sinclair) talks her boyfriend and three other couples into playing hide-and-seek in a furniture store.

title: 50 States of Fright
description:
S01 E01 — The Golden Arm (Michigan) -- Part 1
Heather offers Dave a helping hand, but she may never see that hand again.

title: 50 States of Fright
description:
S01 E02 — The Golden Arm (Michigan) -- Part 2
Obsessed with her beauty, Heather insists on an arm replacement made of gold, but it comes at a cost.

title: 50 States of Fright
description:
S01 E03 — The Golden Arm (Michigan) -- Part 3
Dave goes against Heather's last wish to get out of debt, but when someone breaks a promise, the fallout can be deadly.

title: Mortuary
description: A girl (Mary McDonough) and her boyfriend (David Wallace) suspect her mother (Lynda Day George) and an undertaker are embalming people too soon.

title: The Nest
description: A scientist, a sheriff, an exterminator and an island mayor's daughter go on the hunt for mutant meat-eating cockroaches that are terrorizing a peaceful New England fishing village.

title: The Convent
description: A coed (Joanna Canton) and a former mental patient (Adrienne Barbeau) battle Satanists who slaughter and transform students into evil undead creatures.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E03 — The V Word
Two teenage boys break into a mortuary to see dead bodies, but what they find is more than they bargained for.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E04 — Sounds Like
A man whose job is to monitor his company's telephone conversations finds his sense of hearing becoming more intense.

title: Fear Itself
description:
S01 E13 — The Circle
People who meet each Halloween to tell horror stories suddenly realize they are living one.

title: Fear Itself
description:
S01 E03 — Family Man
A prisoner must protect his family when he inadvertently switches bodies with a serial killer after a near-death experience.

title: Amityville: A New Generation
description: A photographer is given an old mirror and demonic forces project a grisly fate upon the mirror's surface.

title: Amityville Dollhouse
description: A girl (Rachel Duncan) unwittingly releases evil spirits lurking within her toy house, which wreak havoc upon her family.

title: Amityville: It's About Time
description: An antique clock brought back from New York brings supernatural terror to a California neighborhood.

title: Amityville: The Evil Escapes
description: When a widow and her three children move into her mother's house, they come into contact with a supernatural force.

title: Sweet 16
description: Murder and mayhem seem to surround the new girl (Aleisa Shirley) in town as her 16th birthday approaches.

title: Sleepaway Camp
description: Bunks and the showers are a mad stabber's beat at a summer camp strictly for teens.

title: Silent Night, Deadly Night Part 2
description: The younger sibling of the teenager who killed while dressed as Santa carries on in his brother's bloody footsteps.

title: The Invitation
description: While attending a dinner party at his former house, a man starts to believe that his ex-wife and her new husband have sinister plans for the guests.

title: The Exorcist III
description: A police detective (George C. Scott) investigates a series of slayings done in the style of an executed killer (Brad Dourif).

title: The Slumber Party Massacre
description: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

title: Housebound
description: A would-be thief (Morgana O'Reilly) is remanded to the custody of her estranged mother (Rima Te Wiata), who turns out to be correct in her assertion that evil spirits are afoot in their family domicile.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E02 — Family
A young couple's dream home comes complete with a neighbor who seems normal but hides a very dark secret.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E06 — Pelts
A dead family of raccoons, killed mercilessly for their fur, takes revenge on anyone who wears the coat made of its pelts.

title: Grizzly
description: A bloodthirsty grizzly bear stalks two estranged brothers (James Marsden, Thomas Jane) in the Alaskan wilderness.

title: Nightbreed
description: A young man's quest to end his nightmares leads him to a cemetery where monsters have retreated to escape mankind.

title: The Little Shop of Horrors
description: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

title: Piranha
description: Two people (Bradford Dillman, Heather Menzies) unwittingly free a mad military scientist's (Kevin McCarthy) mutant fish near a summer camp and resort lake.

title: Alligator
description: A herpetologist helps a detective track her flushed-away pet, now a king-size mutant called Ramone.
